lines: Only two people on this front will ever fly.
One pilot for the Hegemony. One for the Concord.
From the air, the pilot sees every trench on the line.
Your riflemen shoot better while the plane is up.
The Concord flies too. Two planes. One sky.
But the ground shoots back. Rifles. Machine guns. Flak.
Fly long enough, and the ground will find you.
One pilot per side. The Trench Gazette names them, by lottery.
New here? Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD with PILOT, and you enlist.
